name: container-security
description: Write and review Dockerfiles, Helm charts and Kubernetes or OpenShift manifests with rules for the risks in the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP Kubernetes Top 10: images that run as a user that is not root and with a random user ID, pinned base images, no secrets in layers, a restricted security context, no host access, secrets from Secret objects, least-privilege RBAC, and oc and kubectl commands that do not show secrets or change the cluster. Keeps answers in proportion: minimal fixes, no invented tags, paths or user IDs, and no findings for safe settings.
